title: Skill Preference Pair
description: DPO training record for whole-skill promote/discard/merge/edit verdicts. Every operator decision on a proto-skill is a high-quality preference signal: the chosen skill encoding beats all alternatives. Feeds the skill-writer model and the evolution recommender. Pair with skill_section_preference.schema.json for section-level granularity.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the verdict was recorded.

projectid.description: gad project scope. Null = framework-level candidate (in vendor/get-anything-done .planning/proto-skills/).

decision_kind.description: The operator's top-level action on the proto-skill. Determines which conditional block is required.

candidate_slug.description: The proto-skill slug being reviewed. Must match a directory name in .planning/proto-skills/ at review time.

verdict_source.description: What triggered this verdict. operator_review = direct operator decision. discovery_battery = findability test surfaced it. shed_audit = evolution shed scan selected/rejected it. proto_skill_battery = battery supersession test drove decision.

skill_under_review.description: Full content of the proto-skill at review time. Verbatim capture enables section-diff mining downstream.

draft_path.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to the proto-skill directory at capture time.

skill_md_content.description: Full verbatim content of SKILL.md at review time.

workflow_md_content.description: Full verbatim content of workflow.md if present.

candidate_md_content.description: Full verbatim content of CANDIDATE.md — the source signal that triggered drafting.

rationale.description: Operator's plain-language reason. Even one sentence is valuable training signal. Explains why this verdict beats alternatives.

promoted_to.description: Required when verdict=promoted. framework = promoted into canonical vendor/get-anything-done/skills/. project = promoted into <projectRoot>/skills/.

promoted_at.description: Required when verdict=promoted. ISO timestamp of actual promotion (gad evolution promote ran).

expected_trigger_patterns.description: Required when verdict=promoted. Operator-confirmed phrases that should fire this skill. High-value for trigger-DPO.

expected_anti_patterns.description: Required when verdict=promoted. Phrases or contexts this skill should refuse to fire on — scoping signal.

discard_reason.description: Required when verdict=discarded. Categorical reason. redundant_with_existing = superseded_by_skill_id covers it. not_battle_tested = concept is right but the skill hasn't been exercised enough to promote confidently.

superseded_by_skill_id.description: Required when discard_reason=redundant_with_existing. The slug of the existing installed skill that already covers this content.

merged_into_skill_id.description: Required when verdict=merged_with. Slug of the target skill that absorbed this proto-skill's content.

retained_sections.description: Required when verdict=merged_with. Which section_kind values from the proto-skill survived into the merged skill.

required_changes.description: Required when verdict=needs_edit. Array of per-section change requests.

section.description: Which section of the skill needs changing. Use section_kind values from skill_section_preference.schema.json.

change.description: What change is required. Specific enough that an agent can execute it without operator follow-up.

reason.description: Why this change is required. Training signal for section_preference rows derived from the edit.

re_review_after_edit.description: Required when verdict=needs_edit. True = operator wants to review again after changes. False = changes are mechanical and can auto-promote after edit.

operator_id.description: Operator email or handle. Used for per-operator DPO weighting.

Any time you are writing, reviewing, or debugging a worker loop that dispatches work to a child runtime...

# Workflow: Worker-Side Complete Handoff

## Steps
1. Before dispatching to child runtime: confirm the worker loop owns the completeHandoff call...

examples.rationale: Captures the dominant root cause of today's claim leak — 66 of 264 handoffs had completed_at null because workers delegated to codex children that silently dropped the call. Trigger phrases match real agent behaviors observed this session. Battle-tested.
expected_anti_patterns: asking how to structure a child runtime prompt
questions about handoff schema fields unrelated to completion

triggers:
  - seeking GAD ecosystem state
  - questions about decisions/tasks/errors/handoffs

# GAD CLI Over File Foraging
...

examples.rationale: Core concept is right and battle-tested. Trigger phrases are too abstract — 'seeking GAD ecosystem state' will not match real agent phrasing. Needs concrete phrases that map to actual agent behaviors observed in traces.

required_changes.change: Replace generic phrases with concrete agent action phrases: 'reading TASK-REGISTRY.xml', 'grep on DECISION-REGISTRY.xml', 'looking up handoff state', 'checking what phase N contains', 'what errors were logged this session'
required_changes.reason: Trigger matching runs against raw agent utterances; abstract phrases like 'seeking GAD ecosystem state' don't match how agents actually phrase information lookups.

required_changes.change: Add a token-cost comparison table: gad ask (1 call, ~400 tokens) vs Glob+Grep+Read cascade (6 calls, ~8400 tokens) for the same planning query.
required_changes.reason: Concrete cost delta is the strongest reinforcement for behavior change; the prose explanation alone is not sufficient.
